title: Data sources and interpretation
text: SCAD repeats events span multiple locations. country-level use, peacebuilder retains one row per positive event ID aggregating. documented -99, -88, -77 death-count values represented missing rather negative deaths. UCDP/PRIO expands conflicts multiple location codes aggregation. ucdp_prio_incidence marks active conflict country-year, ucdp_prio_onset one start_date2 falls year. VPP file equivalent episode-start field; ucdp_vpp_onset retained backwards-compatible alias ucdp_vpp_incidence. Mass Mobilization reports participant size mixture exact numbers, ranges, inequalities, qualitative strings. mm_participants contains maximum exact numeric reports. mm_participants_reported preserves reported strings users can apply substantively appropriate recoding. Legacy campaign episode sources can contain several rows one country-year. add_conflict(aggregate = TRUE) reports count takes missing-safe maximum numeric fields. Use aggregate = FALSE call conflict_data() directly campaign-level observations required. MEC contains 2,734 reformist maximalist contentious episodes worldwide. peacebuilder preserves episode-level rows published variables, using source’s byear year. Fourteen left-censored episodes mec_bdate 1955 source byear 1955. add_conflict(aggregate = TRUE), MEC follows explicit aggregation policy campaign episode sources; use aggregate = FALSE retain individual episodes.

title: Build Peace Science Data Panels
text: Load dataset independently inspection custom merging:
code: panel     <- build_states_panel(1990, 2015, coding_system = "cow") gdp_data  <- load_gdp_data(1990, 2015, coding_system = "cow") vdem_data <- load_vdem_data(   vars          = c("v2x_polyarchy", "v2x_libdem"),   start_year    = 1990,   end_year      = 2015,   coding_system = "cow" ) conflicts <- conflict_data(1990, 2015, dataset = "navco2.1", coding_system = "cow")  # Join on your own terms panel <- panel |>   left_join(gdp_data,  by = c("cow", "year")) |>   left_join(vdem_data, by = c("cow", "year")) |>   left_join(     conflicts |>       group_by(cow, year) |>       summarise(onset = max(nvc2.1_ONSET), .groups = "drop"),     by = c("cow", "year")   )

title: Build Peace Science Data Panels
text: Loads one ten conflict, protest, revolutionary-episode datasets. Every loader honors start_year end_year supports COW GW coding. † bundled source small number records beginning 1899. SCAD’s official coverage 1990–2017, one continuing event recorded 1989 start. country-year sources (scad, ucdp_prio, ucdp_vpp, mm, mmad) pre-aggregated country-year inside conflict_data(). Legacy campaign episode datasets, including MEC, return one row per campaign episode; add_conflict() collapses missing-safe maximum default. Unmatched panel rows remain NA, absence source always evidence zero events. UCDP/PRIO, ucdp_prio_incidence marks active conflict-years ucdp_prio_onset marks first year conflict episode defined source’s start_date2. VPP, prefer ucdp_vpp_incidence; ucdp_vpp_onset remains backwards-compatible incidence alias source episode-start field. Note: ucdp_vpp requires readxl package: install.packages("readxl") MEC requires haven package: install.packages("haven")
code: # Standalone navco   <- conflict_data(1990, 2015, dataset = "navco2.1",  coding_system = "cow") scad    <- conflict_data(1995, 2015, dataset = "scad",      coding_system = "cow") ucdp    <- conflict_data(1990, 2020, dataset = "ucdp_prio", coding_system = "gw") mm_data <- conflict_data(1995, 2015, dataset = "mm",        coding_system = "cow") mmad    <- conflict_data(2005, 2020, dataset = "mmad",      coding_system = "cow") mec     <- conflict_data(1955, 2018, dataset = "mec",       coding_system = "cow")  # Pipeline — all datasets work with add_conflict() panel |> add_conflict(dataset = "navco2.1") panel |> add_conflict(dataset = "ucdp_prio") panel |> add_conflict(dataset = "mmad") panel |> add_conflict(dataset = "mec")  # Raw join without aggregation (for campaign and episode datasets) panel |> add_conflict(dataset = "navco1.3", aggregate = FALSE) panel |> add_conflict(dataset = "mec", aggregate = FALSE)

what: Add conflict or protest data to a state panel — add_conflict
title: Add conflict or protest data to a state panel — add_conflict
text: Joins conflict, protest, revolutionary episode dataset onto existing state panel country-year level. Country-year datasets ("scad", "ucdp_prio", "ucdp_vpp", "mm", "mmad") already country-year level loaded, aggregate argument effect . Campaign episode datasets ("navco1.3", "navco2.1", "beissinger", "csra", "mec") can multiple rows per country-year. aggregate = TRUE (default) collapsed country-year taking maximum numeric columns, n_campaigns count column added. Set aggregate = FALSE keep campaign-level rows (may produce duplicates).

title: Add conflict or protest data to a state panel — add_conflict
code: add_conflict(panel, dataset, aggregate = TRUE)

title: Add conflict or protest data to a state panel — add_conflict
text: panel data frame produced build_states_panel(). dataset Dataset load. One : "navco1.3" NAVCO 1.3 campaign onsets (1900-2019). "navco2.1" NAVCO 2.1 campaign-years (1945-2013). "beissinger" Beissinger revolutionary episode onsets (1900-2014). "csra" HSE CSRA revolutionary episodes (2000-2024). "scad" SCAD 2018 social conflict events, Africa Latin America (recorded starts 1989-2017). Prefix: scad_. "ucdp_prio" UCDP/PRIO Armed Conflict Dataset v26.1 (1946-2025). Prefix: ucdp_prio_. "ucdp_vpp" UCDP Violent Political Protest v26.1 (1989-2025). Prefix: ucdp_vpp_. Requires readxl package. "mm" Mass Mobilization Project v4 (1990-2020). Prefix: mm_. "mmad" Mass Mobilization Autocracies Database (2003-2022). Prefix: mmad_. "mec" Major Episodes Contention (1955-2018), global episode-level coverage. Prefix: mec_. Requires haven package. aggregate Logical. TRUE (default), aggregates country-year joining (relevant campaign episode datasets ). FALSE, performs raw left join.

title: Add conflict or protest data to a state panel — add_conflict
text: input panel conflict/protest columns added via left join. Unmatched country-years remain NA; function assume unobserved event indicator zero.

title: Add conflict or protest data to a state panel — add_conflict
code: panel <- build_states_panel(1990, 2010, coding_system = "cow") |>   add_conflict(dataset = "navco2.1") #> Multiple campaigns or episodes per country-year detected in 'navco2.1'. Aggregating to country-year using max() for numeric columns. Use `aggregate = FALSE` or `conflict_data()` for record-level data.  panel <- build_states_panel(1990, 2010, coding_system = "cow") |>   add_conflict(dataset = "ucdp_prio")  panel <- build_states_panel(2005, 2020, coding_system = "cow") |>   add_conflict(dataset = "mmad")  # Raw join for legacy datasets — researcher handles aggregation manually panel <- build_states_panel(1990, 2010, coding_system = "cow") |>   add_conflict(dataset = "navco1.3", aggregate = FALSE)  # MEC is episode-level; keep individual episodes with aggregate = FALSE if (requireNamespace("haven", quietly = TRUE)) {   panel <- build_states_panel(1990, 2010, coding_system = "cow") |>     add_conflict(dataset = "mec", aggregate = FALSE) }

text: Added Major Episodes Contention (MEC) dataset: 2,734 globally covered reformist maximalist episodes 1955 2018. MEC available conflict_data(dataset = "mec") add_conflict(dataset = "mec"). Episode-level rows preserved unless existing aggregate = TRUE policy requested.

title: peacebuilder 0.1.0
text: conflict_data() now applies start_year end_year consistently every bundled source. UCDP/PRIO output now distinguishes conflict incidence episode onset. ucdp_prio_onset based start_date2; new ucdp_prio_incidence column identifies active conflict-years. SCAD country-year totals now exclude UCDP placeholder records, deduplicate multi-location rows event ID, treat documented negative death-count codes missing. -missing groups now produce NA instead -Inf, NaN, associated warnings conflict aggregation. Mass Mobilization participant strings retained mm_participants_reported; mm_participants summarizes exact numeric reports. add_conflict() longer re-aggregates sources already unique country-year, preventing character-valued source fields dropped.

title: peacebuilder 0.1.0
text: Added as_peacesciencer_panel() supply state-year key aliases metadata required peacesciencer preserving peacebuilder’s API. Added add_from_peacesciencer() apply state-year peacesciencer function keeping temporary ccode/gwcode keys result. Restored previously exported build_states_cow_panel() entry point compatibility peacebuilder 0.0.1. Added strict validation years, logical flags, panel keys, output-key uniqueness. Added ucdp_vpp_incidence. existing ucdp_vpp_onset column remains compatibility alias now documented incidence rather onset. Removed magrittr dependency favor R’s native pipe.
